name: Brute Strength
body:
With a ferocious burst of brute strength you can bust through tough objects.

Prerequisite: Mahrog, Str 15.

Benefit: You gain a +4 competence bonus to Strength checks made to break or burst items and objects with a sudden force.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
